description: This file defines the class SawVoice, a subclass of SynthVoice, which implements a sawtooth wave oscillator with an ADSR envelope for a synthesizer. It manages oscillator creation, pitch, amplitude, and envelope control methods, and provides a render method to generate the audio output.

classes.name: SawVoice
classes.description: A class representing a sawtooth oscillator with an ADSR envelope, extending SynthVoice to produce a specific instrument sound.

methods.name: SawVoice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the oscillator and envelope instances.

methods.name: createOscillator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SawOscillator instance.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Handles note-on event, setting pitch and amplitude, and triggering the envelope.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Handles note-off event, releasing the envelope.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets the frequency scaler for the oscillator.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the audio sample by combining oscillator output and envelope.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the envelope has finished its cycle.
